<thought>Since neither the required carboxylic acid nor the achiral methyl ester is commercially available, I searched for a commercially available acyl chloride that contains the same bicyclic core. The acyl chloride O=C(Cl)[C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O is listed in the catalog and is inexpensive. Reacting this acyl chloride with methanol (a cheap, buyable reagent) in a single-step esterification gives the target methyl ester. Both precursors are commercially available and their combined price is well below the $405 budget, satisfying the one‑step requirement.</thought>
<action>is_buyable</action>
